payload_contract: Four manifest rows uniquely bind the four nonmanifest members by exact bytes and SHA-256.
Manifest/review load ID and evidence/review tokens agree; exact evidence canonicalization and unchanged handoff.review_version reproduce the identities.
Evidence contains all six native section arrays; every record is an object bound to the same exact load ID. Unknown record fields are retained.
Saved review is null or an object; its recorded state and fields are displayed as supplied, never promoted to present approval.
Reject duplicate JSON object keys and nonfinite JSON values because the native producer never emits either.
comparison: Exact same nonempty string load ID required; no cross-load change claim.
Canonical JSON string keys preserve numeric/boolean/null distinctions, unknown fields, order within a record and occurrence counts.
Section tables show A/B/unchanged/A-only/B-only occurrence counts; full escaped records appear in all three groups without truncation.
Show full escaped saved review/history for both copies plus exact identities and packet hashes.
Include source ZIP identities; changes confined to cover/container bytes must remain visible as such, without claiming changed evidence.
No packet/index HTML execution, external assets, dynamic fetching, or current app access.
writer: Read each supplied ZIP into memory once and validate both before output creation.
Render all report bytes before exclusive output.open('xb').
Do not create parent directories or replace any existing target.
An I/O failure during an already-created report write may retain a partial new output; do not claim atomic publication.
Input/result paths use existing Path/argparse interfaces, Python standard library only.
tests: Reuse unchanged native build_bundle as fixture producer.
Use frozen same/departure/multiplicity/literal controls plus review-only/cover-only/different-load.
Exercise validation of both sides before writer, existing destination refusal, and supplied order.
Tests invoke this standalone module entry; original CLI/main/pipeline/web are untouched.
No old source suites or native browser checks unless a concrete changed-input risk requires them.
